title: Harry Turner investigates UAP sightings at Maralinga
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Harry Turner investigates UAP sightings at Maralinga, about 1950s-1960s at Maralinga and Woomera, Australia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he was invited to investigate multiple UAP UAP sightings that took place at Maralinga during the sightings.

plain: Ross Coulthart, an Australian journalist, says that a man named Harry Turner was invited to investigate several sightings of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, at Maralinga, an Australian site used for British nuclear weapons tests in the 1950s and 60s, near the Woomera rocket range. Coulthart draws on the work of Bill Chalker, an Australian UFO researcher. If true, it would mean unknown objects showed up during nuclear tests and officials looked into them.
